title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Exclude modern groups / include dynamic security groups support for sensitivity label policies
description: To provide more flexibility, admins can now exclude modern Microsoft 365 groups and scope sensitivity label policies to dynamic and non-mail enabled security groups—expanding policy targeting beyond individual users and mail enabled groups.
